warm-cream.$description: Warm Cream — Primary page canvas, card surfaces — warm off-white replaces stark white to soften the photography-first layout and avoid the cold SaaS feel

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Image borders, elevated card surfaces, contrast panel behind embedded media

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary text, hairline borders, icon strokes, navigation typography — the structural anchor of the entire system

pebble.$description: Pebble — Muted body text, secondary borders, disabled states — the one step above placeholder gray

driftwood.$description: Driftwood — Helper text, low-emphasis captions, subtle dividers

mist.$description: Mist — Light hairline dividers, nav separators, input borders in resting state

ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Orange wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

f37bolton.$description: Sole typeface across the entire system. Custom geometric sans with tight aperture and industrial DNA. Weight 400 for body, 700 only for display headlines and the wordmark. Tracking runs -0.05em at display sizes down to -0.03em at body, giving headlines a compressed editorial feel and body text a quiet, compact rhythm
